repair_policy: date_raw is always the source string; date is ISO only when the source proves it. Zero-padding, stray quotes and prose dates are lossless and applied; an impossible calendar date is NEVER altered, because the correct day cannot be derived from the source.
heuristic_rule: result==Overturned AND (initial_call matches score/home/plate/run OR play_type/initial_call matches Timing/HP/Home/Plate/Collisions)
